verses.sloka: प्रतप्त इव दुःखेन सोऽपश्यज्जगतीपतिः ।स वृद्धस्तरुणीं भार्यां प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसीम् ॥२-१०-२३॥
verses.transliteration: pratapta iva duḥkhena so'paśyajjagatīpatiḥ ।sa vṛddhastaruṇīṁ bhāryāṁ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasīm ॥2-10-23॥

translations.english: The guileless, old king beheld his youthful wife who was dearer to him than his own life, filled with deceitful intentions. She looked like a severed creeper, like a goddess fallen down, like a 'Kinnari' thrown down on earth, like an 'apsarasa' slipped from heaven, like an illusion torn, like a female deer tied down.
translations.hindi: ऐसा करने से मुझी को नहीं, किन्तु श्रोराम, भरत और बडे- बडे लोगों को-यहाँ तक कि समस्त संसार को बडी प्रसन्नता होगी । हे चारुमुखी ! रामराज्याभिषेक होने दे

verses.sloka: अपापः पापसङ्कल्पां ददर्श धरणीतले ।लतामिव विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां देव तामिव ॥२-१०-२४॥
verses.transliteration: apāpaḥ pāpasaṅkalpāṁ dadarśa dharaṇītale ।latāmiva viniṣkṛttāṁ patitāṁ deva tāmiva ॥2-10-24॥

translations.english: The guileless, old king beheld his youthful wife who was dearer to him than his own life, filled with deceitful intentions. She looked like a severed creeper, like a goddess fallen down, like a 'Kinnari' thrown down on earth, like an 'apsarasa' slipped from heaven, like an illusion torn, like a female deer tied down.
translations.hindi: शुद्ध हृदय महाराज दशरथ दीन हो विलाप करते ए रोने लगे । रोते-रोतेः उनकी दोनों आँखे लाल हो गइ, किन्तु इरान 5 और धमकी से भरे हुए उनके करुण बिलाप पर उस दृष्टा कैकेयी ने कुछ भी ध्यान न दिया

verses.sloka: किन्नरीमिव निर्धूतां च्युतामप्सरसं यथा ।मायामिव परिभ्रष्टां हरिणीमिव संयताम् ॥२-१०-२५॥
verses.transliteration: kinnarīmiva nirdhūtāṁ cyutāmapsarasaṁ yathā ।māyāmiva paribhraṣṭāṁ hariṇīmiva saṁyatām ॥2-10-25॥

translations.english: The guileless, old king beheld his youthful wife who was dearer to him than his own life, filled with deceitful intentions. She looked like a severed creeper, like a goddess fallen down, like a 'Kinnari' thrown down on earth, like an 'apsarasa' slipped from heaven, like an illusion torn, like a female deer tied down.

verses.sloka: क्रेणुमिव दिग्धेन विद्धां मृगयुना वने ।महागज इन्वारण्ये स्नेहात्परिममर्श ताम् ॥२-१०-२६॥
verses.transliteration: kreṇumiva digdhena viddhāṁ mṛgayunā vane ।mahāgaja invāraṇye snehātparimamarśa tām ॥2-10-26॥

translations.english: Like a mighty sheelephant caressing her cow wounded with a poisoned arrow in the forest, he caressed her lovingly.

verses.sloka: परिमृश्य च पाणिभ्यामभिसंत्रस्तचेतनः ।कामी कमलपत्राक्षीमुवाच वनितामिदम् ॥२-१०-२७॥
verses.transliteration: parimṛśya ca pāṇibhyāmabhisaṁtrastacetanaḥ ।kāmī kamalapatrākṣīmuvāca vanitāmidam ॥2-10-27॥

translations.english: With a mind extremely terrified yet passionate, he caressed his lotuseyed wife with his hands, and said:

verses.sloka: न तेऽहमभिजानामि क्रोधमात्मनि संश्रितम् ।देवि केनाभिशप्तासि केन वासि विमानिता ॥२-१०-२८॥
verses.transliteration: na te'hamabhijānāmi krodhamātmani saṁśritam ।devi kenābhiśaptāsi kena vāsi vimānitā ॥2-10-28॥

translations.english: O auspicious queen, I do not know whether your anger is directed at me. I do not know the cause of your anger. By whom have you been offended or disrespected? Why are you lying in the dust? This is causing me great sorrow.

verses.sloka: यदिदं ममम् दुःखाय शेशे क्ल्याणि पांसुषु ।भूमौ शेषे किमर्थं त्वं मयि कल्याणचेतसि ।भूतोपहतचित्तेव मम चित्तप्रमाथिनी ॥२-१०-२९॥
verses.transliteration: yadidaṁ mamam duḥkhāya śeśe klyāṇi pāṁsuṣu ।bhūmau śeṣe kimarthaṁ tvaṁ mayi kalyāṇacetasi ।bhūtopahatacitteva mama cittapramāthinī ॥2-10-29॥

translations.english: While I am here favourably disposed towards you, why are you lying down on the floor like one possessed by an evil spirit? Why are you afflicting my mind?

verses.sloka: सन्ति मे कुशला वैद्यास्त्वभितुष्टाश्च सर्वशः ।सुखितां त्वां करिष्यन्ति व्याधिमाचक्ष्व भामिनि ॥२-१०-३०॥
verses.transliteration: santi me kuśalā vaidyāstvabhituṣṭāśca sarvaśaḥ ।sukhitāṁ tvāṁ kariṣyanti vyādhimācakṣva bhāmini ॥2-10-30॥

translations.english: O lovely one there are, to my best satisfaction, expert physicians in all branches (of medical science). They will restore your health. Tell me your ailment.

verses.sloka: कस्य वा ते प्रियं कार्यं केन वा विप्रियं कृतम् ।कः प्रियं लभतामद्य को वा सुमहदप्रियम् ॥२-१०-३१॥
verses.transliteration: kasya vā te priyaṁ kāryaṁ kena vā vipriyaṁ kṛtam ।kaḥ priyaṁ labhatāmadya ko vā sumahadapriyam ॥2-10-31॥

translations.english: On whom do you wish to bestow favour? Who has caused you displeasure? To whom should I grant favour now? To whom should I cause great displeasure?

verses.sloka: मा रोदीर्मा च कार्षिस्त्वं देवि संपरिशोषणम् ॥२-१०-३२॥
verses.transliteration: mā rodīrmā ca kārṣistvaṁ devi saṁpariśoṣaṇam ॥2-10-32॥

translations.english: O queen shed no tears. Drain not your health. Ask me, and I shall slay one who should not be slain or release one who should be slain. I shall make a poor man rich and a wealthy man poor. (Tell me who are such people).

verses.sloka: अवध्यो वध्यतां को वा को वा वध्यो विमुच्यताम् ।दरिद्रः को भवेदाढ्यो द्रव्यवान्वाप्यकिञ्चनः ॥२-१०-३३॥
verses.transliteration: avadhyo vadhyatāṁ ko vā ko vā vadhyo vimucyatām ।daridraḥ ko bhavedāḍhyo dravyavānvāpyakiñcanaḥ ॥2-10-33॥

translations.english: O queen shed no tears. Drain not your health. Ask me, and I shall slay one who should not be slain or release one who should be slain. I shall make a poor man rich and a wealthy man poor. (Tell me who are such people).

verses.sloka: अहं चैव मदीयाश्च सर्वे तव वशानुगाः ।न ते किम्चिदभिप्रायं व्याहन्तुमहमुत्सहे ॥२-१०-३४॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ caiva madīyāśca sarve tava vaśānugāḥ ।na te kimcidabhiprāyaṁ vyāhantumahamutsahe ॥2-10-34॥

translations.english: My kins and I are under your control. I will make no effort to go even a little against your wishes.

verses.sloka: आत्मनो जीवितेनापि ब्रुहि यन्मनसेच्छसि ।बलमात्मनि जानन्ती न मां शङ्कितुमर्हसि ॥२-१०-३५॥
verses.transliteration: ātmano jīvitenāpi bruhi yanmanasecchasi ।balamātmani jānantī na māṁ śaṅkitumarhasi ॥2-10-35॥

translations.english: If you want to do anything even if it means sacrificing my life, I shall do it. Since you know my strength, it does not behove you to doubt me. I swear on my merits. I will do whatever pleases you.

verses.sloka: करिष्यामि तव प्रीतिं सुकृतेनापि ते शपे ।यावदावर्त ते चक्रं तावती मे वसुन्धरा ॥२-१०-३६॥
verses.transliteration: kariṣyāmi tava prītiṁ sukṛtenāpi te śape ।yāvadāvarta te cakraṁ tāvatī me vasundharā ॥2-10-36॥

translations.english: My authority on the land is extended till such places the wheel of any chariot rotates such as the regions in the east, SindhuSauvira areas, Saurashtra, Southern regions, Banga, Anga, Magadha states, Matsya kingdom and KasiKosala countries which are prosperous places.

verses.sloka: प्राचीनाः सिन्धुसौवीराः सौराष्ट्रा दक्षिणापथाः ।वङ्गाङ्गमगधा मत्स्याः समृद्धाः काशिकोसलाः ॥२-१०-३७॥
verses.transliteration: prācīnāḥ sindhusauvīrāḥ saurāṣṭrā dakṣiṇāpathāḥ ।vaṅgāṅgamagadhā matsyāḥ samṛddhāḥ kāśikosalāḥ ॥2-10-37॥

translations.english: My authority on the land is extended till such places the wheel of any chariot rotates such as the regions in the east, SindhuSauvira areas, Saurashtra, Southern regions, Banga, Anga, Magadha states, Matsya kingdom and KasiKosala countries which are prosperous places.

verses.sloka: तत्र जातं बहुद्रव्यं धनधान्य मजाविकम् ।ततो वृणीष्व कैकेयि यद्यत्त्वं मनसेच्छसि ॥२-१०-३८॥
verses.transliteration: tatra jātaṁ bahudravyaṁ dhanadhānya majāvikam ।tato vṛṇīṣva kaikeyi yadyattvaṁ manasecchasi ॥2-10-38॥

translations.english: There wealth and foodgrains, sheep and goats and many things are produced. O Kaikeyi, ask whichever of these you wish.

verses.sloka: किमायासेन ते भीरु उत्तिष्टोत्तिष्ट शोभने ।तत्वं मे ब्रूहि कैकेयि यतस्ते भयमागतम् ॥२-१०-३९॥
verses.transliteration: kimāyāsena te bhīru uttiṣṭottiṣṭa śobhane ।tatvaṁ me brūhi kaikeyi yataste bhayamāgatam ॥2-10-39॥

translations.english: O lady why do you exert yourself? Arise, arise. O charming Kaikeyi, tell me the cause of your fear. I will dispel it just as the Sun dispels morning mists.

verses.sloka: तत्ते व्यपनयिष्यामि नीहरमिव र्श्मिवान् ।तथोक्ता सा समास्वस्ता वक्तुकामा तदप्रियम् ॥२-१०-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tatte vyapanayiṣyāmi nīharamiva rśmivān ।tathoktā sā samāsvastā vaktukāmā tadapriyam ॥2-10-40॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to, she (Kaikeyi) breathed a sigh of relief. Intending to tell him the unpleasant thing (which was in her mind), she began tormenting her husband all the more. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: परिपीडयितुं भूयो भर्तारमुपचक्रमे ।
verses.transliteration: paripīḍayituṁ bhūyo bhartāramupacakrame ।
